* A11 - Hand-Off-Auto selector switch  **with manual speed potentiometer**
* B11 - Hand-Off-Auto selector switch,  **manual speed potentiometer**  and Stop/Start push buttons

sections.h3: Active High Speed Protection - Product Obsolescence

content: The line side High Speed Switch(es) will operate only for line side internal arcing faults.
The load side High Speed Switch(es) will operate only for load side, of main breakers, internal arcing faults.

In the event that the line side High Speed Switch(es) have operated, the remote upstream over-current protective device must clear the fault within 1 second (the short time rating of the High Speed Switch).
High Speed Switch(es), light detectors, and current transformers are to be configured for full switchgear protection
